∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A =
        (∑' (k : ℕ), QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A k).re

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      Filter.Tendsto (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A))

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      HasSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A) ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A)

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ), A.transpose = A → A.det ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : NeZero p] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ↑p ^ k * ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.primePowerZeroCount p k A) =
    ∑ a, QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ k)))) a 0

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : NeZero p]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k) =
    (∑ a, QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ k)))) a 0) /
      ↑p ^ (4 * k)

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A (k + 1)) =
    ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k) +
      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A (k + 1)

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : NeZero p]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ), QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A 0 = 1

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A j

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      ¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
        ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) =
          (1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p ^ 2) / (1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p)

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (p : ℕ)
  [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        ¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
          ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) = (1 - χ ↑p / ↑p ^ 2) / (1 - χ ↑p / ↑p)

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        ∀ (p : Nat.Primes),
          ¬↑p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
            QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p = 1 - χ ↑↑p / ↑↑p ^ 2

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        ∀ (p : Nat.Primes),
          ¬↑p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
            ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / ↑↑p ^ 2

∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.det ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ (p : Nat.Primes) in Filter.cofinite, ¬↑p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        Summable fun p => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p - 1‖

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        Multipliable (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A)

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime ℓ)],
          ¬ℓ ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑ℓ = ↑(legendreSym ℓ A.det)) →
        Multipliable fun p => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p‖

∀ (m n : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (a : ℤ),
  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integralQuadraticGaussSum (m * n) A (↑n * a) 0 =
    ↑n ^ 4 * QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integralQuadraticGaussSum m A a 0

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ∑ a, QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticGaussSum (p ^ (k + 1)) (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ (k + 1))))) a 0 =
    QuaternaryQuadraticForms.unweightedCompleteSum (p ^ (k + 1)) A 0 +
      ↑p ^ 4 * ∑ b, QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ k)))) b 0

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : NeZero p] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A 0 = 1

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℤ),
  ‖↑(legendreSym p a)‖ ≤ 1

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ), ‖↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p‖ < 1

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    ¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A (k + 1) = (1 - 1 / ↑p) * (↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p) ^ (k + 1)

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    ¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      HasSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A)
        ((1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p ^ 2) / (1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p))

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : NeZero p] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 → ∀ (k : ℕ), ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A k‖ ≤ 4 * √|↑A.det| * (1 / ↑p) ^ k

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A → A.det ≠ 0 → Summable fun k => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A k‖

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ), A.transpose = A → A.det ≠ 0 → Summable (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A)

∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      Filter.Tendsto (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A)) ∧
        (Summable fun k => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A k‖) ∧
          HasSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A) ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) ∧
            (¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
              ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) =
                (1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p ^ 2) / (1 - ↑(legendreSym p A.det) / ↑p))

∀ (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  A.transpose = A →
    A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
          ¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A → χ ↑p = ↑(legendreSym p A.det)) →
        (∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
            Filter.Tendsto (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A)) ∧
              (Summable fun k => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A k‖) ∧
                HasSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localDensityTerm p A)
                    ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) ∧
                  (¬p ∣ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
                    ↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.localQuadraticDensity p A) = (1 - χ ↑p / ↑p ^ 2) / (1 - χ ↑p / ↑p))) ∧
          (Summable fun p => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p - 1‖) ∧
            Multipliable (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A) ∧
              Multipliable fun p => ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p‖

∀ (p k : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (f : ZMod (p ^ k * p) → ℂ),
  ∑ a, f a = ∑ a, f ↑a + ∑ b, f (↑p * ↑b.val)
